subject: AcmeHealth launch — provisional rate-pathing & capacity request
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeHealth launch — forecast + provisional capacity request

Hi Sofia,

We’re ramping to production for our June feature flip and expect a phased spike the night of 2026-06-25. Attached is a short forecast (per-minute TPS and token distribution) and a short checklist. Key asks:

- Can Redwood provision a temporary rate increase for the week of 2026-06-24 to 2026-07-01? We expect peak sustained egress around 650 reqs/min with 35% of requests at long-context (>= 2k tokens) and the rest short (<= 256).
- We’d like a routing/fallback plan if standard endpoints start throttling (quantized model / reduced seq-length fallback).
- Any required lead time or paperwork for a provisional quota bump? We can sign an MOU or accept a temporary invoice.

Attachment: acme_launch_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet - forecast and per-route breakdown)

Are you available for a 30m prep call tomorrow to align on playbook and canary timing?

Thanks—
Laura Chen
Head of Platform, AcmeHealth
laura.chen@acmehealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeHealth launch — forecast + provisional capacity request

Folks — looping you all in from Acme (forecast attached). Laura has asked for a temporary spike allowance the week of 6/24. Quick read: target peak ~650 rps/min (mixed seq lengths) with some long-context traffic.

What we need to decide quickly:
- Exact quota uplifts (per-key rate limit + burst window) we can provision without Dedicated reservation.
- Whether to pre-configure automatic routing policies to fall back to a quantized / lower-cost variant when token latency climbs.
- Canary plan: timeline for enabling a canary key for ACME + runbook for rollback and blackholing noisy routes.

I started a provisional MAP draft (attachment) listing asks from Product and Capacity. Please reply with numbers we can commit to by EOD so I can confirm to the customer and schedule the prep call.

Attachment: provisional-MAP.md (text)

Thanks,
Sofia
Sr. Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeHealth launch — forecast + provisional capacity request

Thanks for the details — reviewed the forecast. Product position + tolerances below (high level):

- Short answer: we can support a provisional, time-limited uplift without a Dedicated contract if they stay within a defined surge envelope. Proposed uplift: 2x baseline per-key rate for 72 hours with a 30% sustained concurrency cap; burst window up to 3x for <5 minute bursts.
- Fallback routing: we can enable an automatic routing policy that prefers the standard generation model and falls back to a 4-bit-quantized variant when p50 latency > 1.5s or when the token compute budget exceeds configured thresholds. This requires a model-variant tag and a product flag that Neha can toggle.
- Product asks for engineering:
  * expose per-customer route flags for routing-policy override (feature flag work — small change, 1 sprint).
  * add a canary key with separate quotas and a short TTL.

Action items:
- Neha: please confirm what the capacity team can reserve from the shared pool for the 2x uplift for the week of 6/24. Need commitment by COB Monday.
- Marissa / Sofia: coordinate contract wording for a time-limited uplift + billing.
- Aditya: ops, please prepare the runbook steps for enabling fallback routing and rolling back (include thresholds and escalation).

If everyone signs off, we can confirm to Acme and schedule a 30m prep on Monday 6/15.

—Karthik
Director, Product — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acmehealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeHealth launch — forecast + provisional capacity request

Laura — thanks, and great forecast.

Quick summary and commitment from Redwood: we can provision a provisional uplift under Deal ACME-2026-03 as follows:
- Time window: 2026-06-24 00:00 UTC through 2026-07-01 00:00 UTC (can adjust if you need a tighter window).
- Per-key rate: 2x baseline for sustained traffic; short spikes allowed up to 3x for bursts < 5 minutes.
- Fallback: automatic model-variant failover to the quantized path when latency thresholds are hit.
- Billing: temporary uplift billed at a premium rate; we’ll issue an interim invoice post-window. Legal will send a short MOU.

Prep plan: please pick a 30m slot (options below) for a run-through of canary, routing, and rollback:
- Mon 6/15 08:30 PT / 11:30 ET
- Mon 6/15 13:00 PT / 16:00 ET

Attachment: acme_traffic_playbook.pdf (playbook + runbook)

We’ve copied engineering and capacity to finalize the implementation details. Marissa (me) will confirm the exact quota numbers and the invoicing flow once Neha gives the final capacity allocation.

Thanks — looking forward to the launch.
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
